# Upstream provenance

Project Moon's code-review workflow is adapted from:

- Repository: https://github.com/vibemafiaclub/mafia-codereview-harness
- Upstream commit inspected during integration: `e175e34` (`docs: update README`)
- Upstream project metadata/README declares the project as MIT licensed.

Project Moon does not require the Claude Code plugin at runtime. The workflow concepts and command contracts were adapted into provider-independent MCP review tools rather than vendoring the plugin implementation verbatim.
